limits.en: Free to browse, upvote, comment and launch a product on the daily leaderboard.

keyLimits.en: Paid promotion/sponsorship option for companies to promote products; no public price found.

cautions.en: The core product-discovery and launch experience is free; monetization (advertising/sponsorship, a subscription referenced as 'Subscribe' in navigation) has no public dollar pricing visible on the about page.

capabilities.en: Community-driven daily leaderboard ranking new tech products by user votes and reviews.
Discovery across categories including AI, design and developer tools.
Paid advertising/sponsorship option for companies to promote products on the platform.

limitations.en: No transparent public pricing for paid features (advertising, subscription); details require contacting the team.
Ranking depends on community voting, which the about page did not detail in terms of moderation or anti-gaming mechanics.

unknowns: No public pricing figures found for advertising/sponsorship or any subscription tier.
No catalogue alternativeCandidates fit Product Hunt's core discovery/launch use case in the seed list; none selected.
